entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: An ancient time mage who lost his planeswalker spark restoring Shiv, trying to solve Urza's monument, and who agrees to join the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Niambi
entities.description: Teferi's fifty-year-old daughter, who helps him with the monument puzzle.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: The Weatherlight's captain, Teferi's old friend, who holds his planeswalker spark in a Powerstone.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who helps retrieve the artifact.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who detects the monument's trapped ghosts.

entities.name: Shanna Sisay
entities.description: A warrior of the Weatherlight crew who knows the Zhalfir folklore.

entities.name: Raff Capashen
entities.description: A young mage of the Weatherlight crew.

entities.name: Tiana
entities.description: An angel who steers the Weatherlight and rescues Niambi.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Teferi's former friend and ancient artificer who built the monument and hid an artifact from Teferi.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: The demon lord the crew intends to kill.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon Gideon and Liliana plan to fight afterward.

entities.name: Urza's Crystal Orb
entities.description: A dark crystal orb in a cage of silver vines hidden in the monument, one of Urza's devices that could help repair a time rift.

entities.name: Spark Powerstone
entities.description: A small Powerstone Jhoira made at the Thran Mana Rig, holding Teferi's planeswalker spark.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The skyship that rescues the group from the collapsing monument.

entities.name: Urza's Monument
entities.description: A trapped stone monument in the Tivan desert, younger than Teferi, which sinks after its artifact is taken.

entities.name: Tivan Desert
entities.description: The desert where the monument stands.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: A once-advanced nation that Teferi phased partly out of Dominaria to protect it from Phyrexians.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: A land Teferi also phased out and later restored.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: A region where Teferi and Niambi live.

entities.name: Suq'Ata
entities.description: A city with Zhalfirin exiles.

entities.name: Thran Mana Rig
entities.description: The place where Jhoira made the spark Powerstone.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: The Cabal's fortress the crew must break into.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: The death cult led by Belzenlok.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders from whom Teferi sought to protect Zhalfir.

entities.name: Zhalfir time rift
entities.description: The rift Teferi made to phase Zhalfir out of the plane to save it, which he cannot undo.

events.summary: Teferi and Niambi return to the monument to attempt its puzzle again.
events.quote: Mark my words, this time I'll have the answer.

events.summary: Teferi opens the monument's entrance with his staff.
events.quote: A seam opened in the paving

events.summary: Teferi reflexively blasts an automaton apart with a time spell.
events.quote: the time spell he reflexively cast blasted it so hard it separated into its component parts.

events.summary: Niambi's mathematical theory fails after an hour of trying sequences.
events.quote: I was wrong, it's not a mathematical problem.

events.summary: Teferi says Urza had experimental subjects, not friends.
events.quote: Urza didn't have friends, not like you and I have friends.

events.summary: The Weatherlight appears overhead, which Teferi calls his past catching up.
events.quote: It's my past, catching up with me.

events.summary: Jhoira introduces Gideon and Liliana as planeswalkers to Teferi.
events.quote: Gideon and Liliana are Planeswalkers.

events.summary: Jhoira asks Teferi for a time mage to help them enter the Stronghold.
events.quote: We're going to kill Belzenlok and we need a time mage to help us get into the Stronghold.

events.summary: Teferi explains he created a time rift to phase Zhalfir out of Dominaria to protect it from the Phyrexians.
events.quote: So I created a time rift and phased Zhalfir partially out of this plane.

events.summary: Jhoira notes Teferi later returned Shiv and lost his planeswalker spark doing so.
events.quote: That's how he lost his Planeswalker spark.

events.summary: Teferi reveals Urza's devices could help repair the time rift and one lies in the monument.
events.quote: I discovered some time ago that my friend Urza had left behind a series of devices and magical artifacts that could be of some help in repairing a time rift.

events.summary: Teferi says Urza hid the artifact from him.
events.quote: No. From me.

events.summary: Teferi tells Liliana mistakes can eventually be balanced.
events.quote: It isn't possible to erase them, but with effort you can eventually balance your account.

events.summary: Jhoira theorizes Urza cheated, and Liliana looks for ghosts in the chamber.
events.quote: Worse, I think he cheated,

events.summary: Liliana detects trapped spirits that factor into the puzzle.
events.quote: Aha, there are spirits here.

events.summary: Teferi hits the correct square and the platform opens.
events.quote: the square in the center slid ponderously aside to reveal an opening.

events.summary: Teferi retrieves the crystal orb Urza hid.
events.quote: Teferi held a delicate dark crystal orb nestled in a cage of silver vines.

events.summary: The monument begins to collapse.
events.quote: I think this place is collapsing!

events.summary: The group escapes as sand floods the well and the Weatherlight drops ladders.
events.quote: The plateau is sinking.

events.summary: The monument sinks entirely into the earth.
events.quote: the last of the plateau sank into the earth

events.summary: Teferi agrees to join Jhoira in saving the world again.
events.quote: I think I will.

events.summary: Niambi is dropped home and blesses her father's return to adventuring.
events.quote: This is what you were born to do.

events.summary: Jhoira reveals she holds Teferi's planeswalker spark in a Powerstone and must convince him to take it back.
events.quote: It held Teferi's Planeswalker spark.

relations.quote: You know we need your help.

relations.note: Urza hid his artifact from Teferi.
She made the stone holding Teferi's spark.
relations.quote: She had made this stone herself at the Thran Mana Rig.

relations.note: He made the rift that phased Zhalfir out.
relations.quote: So I created a time rift and phased Zhalfir partially out of this plane.

relations.note: They are working together against Belzenlok.
relations.quote: But we're committed to killing Belzenlok.

relations.note: Raff helps Jhoira on the Weatherlight.
relations.quote: Jhoira and Raff cast defensive spells on the ledge
